qa.question: When this card is a digivolution card of a Digimon with <Digi-Burst> that activates at [On Play] or [When Digivolving] timings, is this card's inherited effect not applied outside of those timings?
qa.answer: This card's inherited effect is applied even during times where the Digimon can't activate <Digi-Burst>.

qa.question: When this card is a digivolution card of a Digimon with <Digi-Burst> that requires a certain number of digivolution cards to activate, is this card's inherited effect not activated unless the Digimon can activate <Digi-Burst>?
qa.answer: This card's inherited effect is applied even if the Digimon doesn't have enough digivolutions to activate <Digi-Burst>.

qa.question: I have 9 cards in my trash and a Digimon with this card as a digivolution card is deleted in battle. The deleted cards, including this one, are sent to my trash, and now I have over 10 cards in my trash. Does this card's <Retaliation> activate?
qa.answer: No. You lose this card's inherited effect when it is placed in the trash, so it can't activate.

qa.question: I have 10 or more cards in my trash and a Digimon with this card as a digivolution card is deleted in battle. Before this card's effect has a chance to activate, another effect activates and reduces the number of cards in my trash to 9 or less. Does this card's <Retaliation> activate?
qa.answer: Yes, if you had 10 or more cards when it was deleted, you can activate <Retaliation>.

qa.question: If this card is a digivolution card and is trashed by <Digi-Burst>, when does this card return to hand: before or after <Digi-Burst> activates?
qa.answer: After <Digi-Burst> activates.

qa.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: 1 [Hybrid] trait Digimon card and 1 red Tamer card.

qa.question: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.
In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

qa.question: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
qa.answer:
Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
qa.answer:
No, it can't.
Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

qa.question: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
qa.answer:
Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: If I've digivolved this card on top of a tamer card and the Digimon is deleted, what happens to the tamer card?
qa.answer: It is trashed.

qa.question: Is digivolution from a Tamer using BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s 1st effect possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?
qa.answer:
Yes, such digivolution is possible.
Effects that add to card information for digivolution aren't the same as effects that ignore digivolution requirements.

qa.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
qa.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon is played by an effect such as the effect on BT5-092 [Nokia Shiramine] or when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

qa.question: My opponent's red Tamer digivolves into a [BT4-011 Agunimon] when my Digimon has this card in its digivolution cards. Does the digivolution cost increase by 1?
qa.answer: Yes, the digivolution cost increases by 1. [BT4-011 Agunimon]'s effect reads "You may Digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 Digimon," so the Tamer is considered to be a Digimon without digivolution cards, and the digivolution cost increases by 1 due to this card's inherited effect.

qa.question: My Digimon has this card in its digivolution cards. Does the digivolution cost increase by 1 when my opponent digivolves a red Tamer with cards under it into a [BT4-011 Agunimon]?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. [BT4-011 Agunimon]'s effect reads "You may Digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 Digimon," so a Tamer with cards under it is considered to be a Digimon with digivolution cards.

qa.question: My opponent activates this card's [On Play] effect. Can I digivolve an unsuspended Tamer into a [BT4-011 Agunimon] in the next turn?
qa.answer: No, you can't. [BT4-011 Agunimon]'s effect reads "You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 red Digimon," so it is considered to be an unsuspended Digimon and can't digivolve.

qa.answer:

qa.question: If 2 of my red and/or yellow Tamers are suspended at different timings, does this Digimon gain <Security Attack +1> twice?

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "return 1 of your other Digimon to its owner's hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my token that was played as a Digimon from the battle area to the hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your token is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be removed from the game instead of being returned to the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect work with any color of tamer?
qa.answer: Yes. Since there's no color specified in the effect, it will work with any color tamer.

qa.question: When this Digimon attacked, my opponent didn't have any Digimon with digivolution cards, and I wasn't able to use the [When Attacking] effect to trash digivolution cards. Do I still get to trigger <Draw 1> and gain 1 memory?
qa.answer: No. If you didn't trash any digivolution cards with the [When Attacking] effect, you don't get to trigger <Draw 1> or gain 1 memory.

qa.question: When I digivolved into this card, my opponent had 3 or less cards in their hand. Do I still gain memory from the [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, you don't.

qa.question: What exactly does "this Digimon is unblockable" mean?
qa.answer: If you have a Digimon with this effect, your opponent's Digimon can't block against its attacks.

qa.question: Does "this Digimon is unblockable" mean this Digimon can't attack my opponent's suspended Digimon?
qa.answer: No. Attacking suspended Digimon isn't blocking, so you can attack them.

qa.question: Does this card's [At End of Opponent's Turn] effect mean that if I have no cards left in my security stack, at the end of my opponent's turn I lose the game?
qa.answer: No. The effect only trashes cards from your security stack and isn't the same as you taking an attack. If you have no cards left in your security stack at the end of your opponent's turn, you continue the game as normal.

qa.question: Do the [Security] effects on cards trashed by this card's [At End of Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: No, they don't.

qa.answer: No, you can choose not to.

qa.answer: No. If you can't add cards from your security stack to your hand, you can't activate the effect.

qa.question: I attack with this Digimon, then activate its [When Attacking] effect to unsuspend it and give 1 of my opponent's Digimon -6000 DP. If I attack again on the same turn, can I give 1 of my opponent's Digimon an additional -6000 DP?
qa.answer: No. The effect has [Once Per Turn], so it doesn't activate on any attacks past the first one.

qa.answer: No, digivolving doesn't count as the card being played, so you can't suspend it.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend a level 4 or lower Digimon when it moves from the breeding area to the battle area?
qa.answer: No. Moving from the breeding area doesn't count as the card being played, so you can't suspend it.

qa.answer: No. When [BT4-066 Golemon] is deleted, reducing the DP of your opponent’s Digimon, this card’s effect will have already finished activating. As such, you cannot choose additional Digimon with this card’s effect midway.

qa.question: Does this card's effect also activate for [BT4-066 Golemon] itself?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: I have 2 copies of this Digimon in my battle area, and both are deleted at the same time by an opponent's skill. Do both copies activate their [On Deletion] skills?

qa.question: My opponent attacks with [BT4-075 Blastmon]. If I have an unsuspended Digimon in play, am I forced to switch the target of attack to it?

qa.answer: No, you can activate it when digivolving into any Digimon with <Digi-Burst>.

qa.question: When my opponent's Digimon attacks and checks my security, I activate this card's effect to gain 1 memory, moving the memory counter to 1 on my side. Does the attack end, even if my opponent's Digimon has checks remaining from <Security Attack +1>?
qa.answer: No, as long as there are attacks and effects that have triggered but haven't finished resolving yet, the attack continues regardless of the memory gauge's current position.

qa.question: While this Tamer is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but can I still suspend this card to gain 1 memory?
qa.answer: Yes, because a card was removed from your security stack.

qa.question: While this Tamer is in my battle area, I use [BT1-087 Matt Ishida]'s effect to add a yellow card from my security stack to my hand, triggering <Recovery +1 (Deck)> and adding a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but can I still suspend this card to gain 1 memory?
qa.answer: Yes, because a card was removed from your security stack.

qa.question: If my opponent uses a card like [BT2-020 Gallantmon] to trash a card in my security directly, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I activate an effect like [BT4-104 Blinding Ray] to remove cards from my own security stack, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If this card is played by its [Security] effect, can I suspend it to gain 1 memory?
qa.answer:
"No, you can't.
Since this card hasn't been played when it is revealed from your security, the condition for [When a card is removed from your security stack] can't be triggered, so this card's effect can't be activated."

qa.question: My security cards were revealed due to the [When Digivolving] effect of this opponent's card, and 1 of them was trashed. Can I treat this as "when a card is removed from your security stack" and activate [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can activate it.
When a revealed card is trashed from the deck or security stack, it is not considered to be trashed from the deck or security stack, but it is considered that a card was removed from the security stack, so [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect can be activated.

qa.question: I use this card on one of my Digimon, which I use to attack an opponent's Digimon. Does this count as the Digimon being blocked? Do I gain 3 memory?
qa.answer: No, your opponent has to use <Blocker> to block the attack in order for you to gain 3 memory.

qa.question: I activate this card's [Security] effect. I move a Digimon from my breeding area to the battle area, then play a Digimon from my hand. Do these Digimon get <Security Attack +1> from this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect applies to all of your Digimon, including those that enter the battle area after the start of your turn.

qa.question: Can I use this card when my opponent doesn't have a Digimon with 6000 DP or less in play to play a Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from my hand without paying its memory cost?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I use this card to grant my Digimon this card's effect. I then use one of my Digimon to attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards. Does my opponent's Digimon get deleted in battle?
qa.answer:
No, it's deleted by this card's effect, not by battle.
As such, effects that read, "deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives," and effects like <Retaliation> don't activate.

qa.question: My opponent uses this card during their turn, then attacks one of my Digimon with no digivolution cards. Can I block with one of my other Digimon to prevent that Digimon from being deleted?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect deletes your Digimon before blocker timing.

qa.question: My opponent uses this card during their turn, then attacks one of my Digimon with no digivolution cards. If I block with one of my other Digimon, will it be deleted by this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, the effect granted by this card will only delete the Digimon that was the target of the attack. If you block to force the target of attack to change, the blocking Digimon won't be deleted, and the battle will occur normally.

qa.question: One of my Digimon has been granted the effect from this card. If I use it to attack an opponent's Digimon with higher DP, is my Digimon deleted after losing the battle?
qa.answer: No, you can delete your opponent's Digimon with this card's effect before the battle begins. The attacking Digimon is not deleted.

qa.question: I use this card, then attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards using a Digimon with <Piercing>. Does <Piercing> take effect?
qa.answer: No, a Digimon with <Piercing> has to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive the battle, but this card's effect deletes the opposing Digimon before the battle begins. As such, <Piercing> does not apply.

qa.question: I use [BT-112 Dimension Scissor], which allows 1 of my Digimon to unsuspend every time it deletes an opponent's Digimon. If I then use this card and attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, can I unsuspend my Digimon using Dimension Scissor's effect after deleting the opponent's Digimon using this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, Dimension Scissor requires the Digimon to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive the battle. This card's effect deletes the opposing Digimon before the battle begins, so the effect doesn't apply.

qa.question: I use this card, then attack an opponent's Digimon with 1 digivolution card. If I use a [When Attacking] effect to trash the opposing Digimon's digivolution card, what happens?
qa.answer:
The opposing Digimon isn't deleted by the effect granted by this card.
If the opponent's Digimon has 1 or more digivolution cards at the time you declare the attack, it can't be targeted by the effect granted by this card, even if it loses all of its digivolution cards later.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] from the battle area to the hand, then return up to 2 of my opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to return my token that was played as a Digimon from the battle area to the hand, then return up to 2 of my opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to their owners' hands?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If your token is chosen as the target to return to the hand for this card's effect, it will ultimately be removed from the game instead of being returned to the hand according to the rules, but it meets this card's "by returning 1 of your Digimon to the hand" condition. A card isn't actually added to the hand, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the hand" don't trigger.

qa.question: My opponent has 7 cards in hand. I use this card to return their Digimon to their hand, resulting in them having 8 cards in hand. Does my opponent place that Digimon at the bottom of their deck?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect already returned the Digimon to their hand. The effect doesn't activate again, and the Digimon you chose remains in your opponent's hand.

qa.question: If I activate an effect like [BT4-104 Blinding Ray] to remove cards from my own security stack, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I use this card when my security stack is empty, do I gain 2 memory?
qa.answer: Yes. When your security stack is empty, you gain 2 memory.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to place a Digimon on top of my security stack. Does that Digimon's [On Deletion] effect(s) activate?
qa.answer: It wasn't deleted, so [On Deletion] effects don't activate.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to place my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] on top of my security stack from the battle area?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If your [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, according to the rules it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead of the security stack.
A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to place my token that was played as a Digimon on top of my security stack from the battle area?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If your token is chosen as the target to place in the security stack, according to the rules it's removed from the game instead of being placed in the security stack.
A card isn't actually added to the security stack, therefore effects such as "when a card is added to the security stack" don't trigger.

qa.question: If I choose my [EX2-007 Mother D-Reaper] or token that is treated as a Digimon in the battle area as the target for this card's effect, it isn't placed in the security stack. In such cases, do "when a card is removed from the security stack" effects trigger because a card wasn't added to the security stack even though it normally should have been added?
qa.answer: No, they don’t trigger.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], then I placed this card itself on top of the security stack. At such times, after using BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], will it be placed in the security stack by the "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it will be placed in the security stack.

qa.question: If I use [BT4-105 Tactical Retreat!] on this card, can I place it on top of my security stack face down?
qa.answer: No. This card is a Digi-Egg card, so if it would be moved to your security stack, it’s instead placed at the bottom of your Digi-Egg deck face down.

qa.question: Can I use this card when I have no Digimon to suspend an opponent's Digimon, or when my opponent has no Digimon to unsuspend my own Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, both are possible.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to give a Digimon +3000 DP. If that Digimon now has 16000 DP or more, does it gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>?
qa.answer: Yes, it does. Even if the Digimon's original DP is less than 16000, if it becomes 16000 or greater after getting +3000 DP from this card's effect, it gains <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to give one of my Digimon <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>. If another effect reduces that Digimon to 15000 or less, does it lose <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>?
qa.answer: No. Once the Digimon meets the conditions to gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>, it keeps them until the end of your opponent's next turn, even if its DP is reduced to 15000 or less.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to give a Digimon +3000 DP, but it still has less than 16000 DP. If I then use another DP-boosting effect to raise its DP to 16000 or more, does it gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. The Digimon must have 16000 DP at the time this card's effect is activated for it to gain <Blocker>, <Reboot>, and <Security Attack +1>.

qa.question: This card has an effect that reads, "For each of your Digimon with [D-Brigade] in its type, add +1 to the maximum play cost of the Digimon you can choose with this effect." What does this mean?
qa.answer: If you have a Digimon with [D-Brigade] in its type, you can choose a Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less. (3 or less + 1 = 4 or less.) If you have 2 Digimon with [D-Brigade], you can choose a play cost of 5 or less, if you have 3 Digimon it becomes 6 or less, and so on.

qa.question: If I use this card when I have 9 cards in my trash, does this card become the 10th card in my trash, allowing me to gain 1 memory?
qa.answer: No, Option cards go to the trash after their effects activate, so you still have 9 cards in your trash when the effect checks to see how many cards there are. You don't gain 1 memory.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect on [AncientGarurumon] itself?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What cards are unsuspended by this card's [When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer: Up to 2 total of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in their names or your [Hybrid] trait Digimon.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0232.title: <Digi-Burst>
comprehensive-0232.text:
16-14. <Digi-Burst>
16-14-1. <Digi-Burst> is a keyword effect where another effect specified by this effect will activate by trashing the specified number of digivolution cards from the Digimon with this effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Digi-Burst 1>.
16-14-2. The processing from <Digi-Burst> is optional. For details, refer to 15-6 "Processing Conditions")

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
